name: Ministering To Unsaved
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively share the gospel with all people, as Jesus commanded to preach to every creature (Mark 16:15). This ministry to the unsaved is grounded in the reality of God's love demonstrated through Christ's sacrificial death for sinners (Romans 5:8). Believers, called to live worthy of their vocation (Ephesians 4:1), are to focus on heavenly things (Colossians 3:1) and speak only what aligns with sound doctrine (Titus 2:1), ensuring their witness reflects the truth and grace of Christ.
